results.title: The two-torsion of $C_n(\mathbb Q)$
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: Let $n$ be a positive integer and $C_n:y^2=x^3-n^2x$ over $\mathbb Q$. Then $C_n$ is an elliptic curve, and for each $e\in\{0,n,-n\}$ the point $(e,0)$ is a nonsingular point of $C_n$. A point $P\in C_n(\mathbb Q)$ satisfies $2P=O$ if and only if In particular exactly $4$ points $P\in C_n(\mathbb Q)$ satisfy $2P=O$.

results.title: The Kummer image over $\mathbb Q$ is finite
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: Let $c$ be a nonzero integer. Then the Kummer image $\alpha_c(E_c(\mathbb Q))\subseteq\mathbb Q^\times/\mathbb Q^{\times2}$ of $E_c:y^2=x^3+cx$ is finite.

results.title: The weak Mordell–Weil theorem for $C_n$
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: Let $n$ be a positive integer. Then $2C_n(\mathbb Q)$ has finite index in $C_n(\mathbb Q)$.

results.title: Mordell–Weil for the congruent number curves
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: Let $n$ be a positive integer. The group $C_n(\mathbb Q)$ of rational points of $C_n:y^2=x^3-n^2x$ is finitely generated.
